remarks:
Located on a highly visible .68-acre lot with 93 feet of frontage and 318 feet of depth, this parcel is a developer's dream. Situated in the West Seneca on Ridge Rd andnear the high-traffic intersection of Orchard Park Road, this property boasts an exceptional daily traffic count of over 20,900 vehicles. Currently zoned for multi-use, it is the perfect high-exposure site for a fast-food franchise, retail business, or professional office.

The location is unbeatable: it sits directly across from Aldi and Big Lots, and is surrounded by major consumer traffic drivers including Home Depot, Delta Sonic, Tim Hortons, Wendy's, Mighty Taco, and Seneca Square Plaza. Additionally, it is incredibly well-positioned near the highly anticipated new Costco, guaranteeing an even greater influx of daily shoppers to the immediate area!

While the lot is prime for a brand-new commercial build, the property currently features a solid, move-in ready 3-bedroom brick Cape Cod with a detached garage. This existing structure offers great flexibility to be utilized as an immediate rental property, a converted business office, or seamlessly cleared for your custom development. With easy access to public transit and just minutes from I-90 and Rt 219, this location is the perfect spot for your next profitable venture.
